# JMeter Scripting Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > JMeter

## Overview

Implements advanced JMeter scripting with BeanShell, Groovy, and JSR223 for dynamic test logic, correlation, and data manipulation

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [jmeter-scripting-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
jmeter-scripting-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@jmeter-scripting-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Write Groovy scripts with JSR223 processors
- Extract dynamic values with regex and JSON extractors
- Implement correlation for session management
- Create script-based assertions

## Technology Standards Applied

- **JSR223**: JSR223 scripting with Groovy for performance
- **Correlation**: Dynamic value extraction and injection
- **Groovy**: Preferred scripting language for JMeter
